Container.Name: Collectabase
Container.Overview: Self-hosted collection manager for games, consoles, figures, comics, and more.
Container.Description: Collectabase is a self-hosted collection manager with local image storage, collection analytics, and optional market-price integrations. App data, uploaded images, and automatic backups are stored in persistent host paths. Configure provider credentials in the Collectabase Settings page. Keep SQLite data on local storage, not an SMB share.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: SQLite database and application state. Use local storage, not an SMB share.

Config.Name: Uploaded images
Config.Description: Locally cached cover and uploaded images.

Config.Name: eBay marketplace
Config.Description: Marketplace used for eBay price lookups.

Config.Name: Admin API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional key to protect write operations when exposing the instance beyond your LAN.
